prediction.sql:

FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.XCL_001

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001 AS atom_id, b.XCL_006 AS bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'TR346'
UNION
SELECT a.XCL_001 AS atom_id, b.XCL_006 AS bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'TR346'
